2026-10-23: the Tauri/Svelte/PhaseUI client and its dedicated build, test and CI infrastructure were removed directly. The current route follows the [TUI requirements](../../tui/requirements-and-backend-plan.md); the local browser command interface is documented in [the guide](../../tui/browser-guide.md). See the [operations guide](../operations.md) for Core usage.

Historical design and acceptance are traced through fixed commits. Failed, untested or pending manual GUI acceptance does not become passed because the client is retired.
